detail.longDescription: A little # SailfishOS success tonight! I've been using # PureMaps on my # Jolla phone, but HERE's raster maps had one annoying problem: when navigating south, all the street names ended up upside down! After a bit of experimenting, I've managed to get HERE vector maps working, with readable, rotating maps while keeping HERE's congestion-aware routing. I've put the configuration and instructions on # GitHub in case they're useful to anyone else. https:// github.com/RevMikeG/pure-maps- here-vector # Linux # OpenSource # JollaPhone
